facts.action: 深夜溜出寝宫、贴墙潜行穿过主宫，在几英里外的空地与 Fraener 会合飞离 Arelia；巡守下城边缘的 Chosen 只目送她飞过，无人拦阻
facts.verbatim: out of her bed, slunk through the main palace

facts.action: morn 时 Borderlands 沙漠线在望；她俯身收肘催 Fraener 加速，直奔近边境的 Deadhaven
facts.verbatim: the desert line of the Borderlands

facts.action: 接近时预警锣响（应是 Cezar 望见他们接近而报信），村民奔逃躲避；一道 lightning 袭来被她的金色 shield 挡下——村民认出是她，恐惧瞬间转为欢腾
facts.verbatim: A stream of lightning came hurtling towards her

facts.action: Drunken Trio 挤过人群迎接：Zave 紧抱她、笑说他的东西不再丢；Inara 笑指那是 Felix 干的（他留在王国替她偷重要东西）；Ralf 憋出 'Glad you're not dead'
facts.verbatim: Zave, Lina, and Ralf pushed through the throng of people

facts.action: Cias 唤她全名，她拥抱这位长者（这次他回抱了、说 glad she is okay）；随后在火堆旁喝下他盛的 porridge，问水道余款——他说众人已凑齐；她想到此后有稳定进项，Gideon 的月付会轻松许多
facts.verbatim: the porridge Venerable Cias had served her

facts.action: 她向 Cias 交底：cursed land 正在蔓延、已吞 Blackpeak/Holen/Prector，并复述进展报告、舞会事件、High Council 会议及与 Walder 的谈话（隐去 Bloodborne 与未遂刺杀）；Cias 听得像要昏过去
facts.verbatim: has already consumed Blackpeak, Holen, and Prector

facts.action: 她提议全村准备撤离、必要时越境进入 Arelia；Cias 斥 'They would never allow that'；她自称 'personal Shielder to the Crowned Prince himself'、身份够高，Arelians 交给她摆平
facts.verbatim: best to prepare the village for evacuation

facts.action: 话音未落警报锣大响，有人高喊 'Dragon! Run! Dragon!'；天际出现一个闪烁的黑点——她不必借 Fraener 之眼也认得：Crowned Prince 追来了（章末）
facts.verbatim: The Crowned Prince had come for her.

Inara 与 Zave/Lina/Ralf（'Drunken Trio'）：村中损友——Zave 的东西曾被偷（她笑称是 Felix），Ralf 难得说了句 'Glad you're not dead'
Inara 与 Felix：best friend——他留在王国替她'偷非常重要的东西'
Inara 与 Venerable Cias：'You forget that I helped raise you, girl'——把她抚养长大的村中长者；她先瞒后坦白南方危机
Cezar 与村民：负责警戒——望见 Inara 飞近即鸣锣发预警
Inara 与 Gideon：月付债务关系（'monthly payments to Gideon'；未出场）
Inara 与 Prince Walder：她自称 'personal Shielder to the Crowned Prince himself'；章末他追到 Deadhaven
